verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll, EOR and HR SaaS that holds sensitive workforce data and exposes it to AI clients through an MCP server, so asking whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair question. The evidence pack covers APIs, webhooks, MCP, the CLI and pricing, but nothing about AI training data use, opt-out controls, or a no-training commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
